title: Yellow Smoky Northern Irish Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A traditional Northern Irish dish featuring smoky sausages and creamy mashed potatoes, made with smoky paprika and a mortar-pestle-pound technique. This nut-free-friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the sausages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the sausages are baking, boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with butter, milk, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound the smoky paprika into a fine powder.
Add the pounded paprika to the mashed potatoes and stir until well combined.
Serve the sausages on top of the mashed potatoes and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
